about_subtitle: CREATIVE LABORATORY FOR SOUND AND IMAGE
about_body: Founded in 2009 in Bogotá by Diego Díaz and Leonard Jaramillo, Willow Tree was born as a creative laboratory where sound and image become languages to move, inspire, and transcend. More than a studio, we are a space where artistic passion and technical precision grow together, giving life to unique experiences that blend music, audiovisual production, and storytelling with our distinctive signature, true to our motto 'Ideas that become worlds.'

service_audio_prod_copy: Integral development of musical projects, from composition and arrangements to final delivery, preserving the sonic identity of each artist or brand.
portfolio_audio_prod_desc_title: ORIGINAL MUSIC FOR ARTISTS AND BRANDS
portfolio_audio_prod_desc_body: At Willow Tree, we conceive music as the heart of every project. Our Music Production portfolio covers everything from creating original soundtracks, advertising jingles, and 'sonic branding', to the complete production of albums for artists. We blend our passion for sound with technical precision to ensure every note resonates with the identity and message of your project. We explore genres and styles, always aiming for the highest artistic and sonic quality.

service_audio_rec_copy: Studios equipped with state-of-the-art technology to capture voices, instruments, and ambiances with the highest fidelity and character.
portfolio_audio_rec_desc_title: RECORDING STUDIOS: WILLOW TREE X BASSWALK
portfolio_audio_rec_desc_body:
The alliance between Willow Tree and Basswalk Studios creates an ideal space for musical and audiovisual production, combining technical excellence and comfort. Artists and creators can record with advanced technology and varied instruments in an environment that inspires freedom and enhances creativity.

**Microphones**
* AKG C414 XLII – multi-pattern reference condenser.
* Shure SM57 – standard for instruments and snares.
* Shure SM58 Wireless – professional wireless vocal system.
* Electro-Voice RE20 – classic studio dynamic microphone.
* Drum microphone kit – Sennheiser e600 Drum Pack (e602-II, e604, e614).
* And a wide additional collection of condenser, ribbon, and dynamic microphones.

**Instruments**
* Alesis Strike Pro SE electronic drum kit.
* Pearl Masters Maple Complete acoustic drum kit.
* Percussion: LP Galaxy Giovanni congas, Meinl bongos, marimbas, lyres, Tibetan singing bowls, and assorted ethnic accessories.
* Guitars: Fender Stratocaster American Professional, Gibson Les Paul Standard 60s, PRS Custom 24, Ibanez RG Prestige.
* Basses: Fender Jazz Bass American Ultra, Music Man StingRay Special.

**Audio Gear**
* Pro Tools HD as the main recording and mixing system.
* Analog Mastering with: Manley Massive Passive EQ, Shadow Hills Mastering Compressor, Empirical Labs Distressor EL8X.
* Avalon VT-737sp Channel Strip.
* Universal Audio Apollo x8p for interface and conversion.
* Virtual instrument suites: Native Instruments Komplete 14, Spectrasonics Omnisphere, Arturia V Collection, U-He Diva and more.
service_audio_mix_master_copy: Fusion of sonic balance, spatiality, and final optimization to elevate your recordings to their maximum aesthetic and distribution potential.
portfolio_audio_mix_master_desc_body:
Mixing breathes life into your music, transforming individual tracks into a unified sonic experience. We meticulously adjust stereo panorama, dynamics, and creative effects. Mastering is the final polish: we optimize the sound for distribution on digital platforms, CD, and vinyl.

We work with **cutting-edge software**, such as the Universal Audio, FabFilter, and Waves plugin suites, complemented by the precision of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** assisted analysis to ensure the highest quality and competitive loudness according to modern industry standards.
video_prod_copy: Integral production of audiovisual projects, from script to final delivery for TV, cinema, and digital platforms.
portfolio_video_prod_desc_body: We are a full team ready to bring your vision to life. We handle all phases of production: pre-production, direction, lighting, filming with cinematic equipment, and direct sound. Our experience ensures that every frame captures the emotion and story you want to convey.
video_post_copy: Professional video editing, color correction (grading), sound design, and mixing to ensure the highest technical and artistic quality.
portfolio_video_post_prod_desc_title: EDITING, COLOR GRADING, AND SOUND DESIGN
portfolio_video_post_prod_desc_body: Post-production is the final touch. We offer agile editing services, advanced color correction (DaVinci Resolve) to achieve the desired 'look', and immersive sound design, perfectly synchronizing audio and video.
video_motion_copy: Creation of 2D and 3D animation, Motion Graphics for advertising, explainer videos, and animated infographics with visual impact.
portfolio_video_anim_desc_body: We turn complex ideas into dynamic visual narratives. Whether it's traditional animation, 3D rendering, or motion graphics for social media, our team creates pieces that capture attention and explain concepts with clarity and style.
description_dkong:
Dkong is a multidisciplinary artist who blends hip hop with a wide range of rhythms, sound textures, and striking visuals. His work merges lyrics with esoterism, magical realism, and futuristic visions [Antenna].

Based in Bogotá, he tells both personal and collective stories through music and visuals that bridge the intimate and the universal.
description_leo: Leo Jaramillo is a musician, producer, and sound engineer originally from Bogotá, with over a decade of experience on big stages and studios. He is a recognized instrumentalist, able to fuse reggae, dub, and hip hop with an authentic and original approach. For beats and tracks purchase, write to jaramilloleomusic@gmail.com. All music is original by Leo Jaramillo.
